title: Nexus AgentScanEntry
description: A single ACP agent entry annotated with local PATH-install availability. Returned by POST /v1/daemon/agent-host/scan. Each entry maps to one registry agent (or a custom wizard-supplied launch command) with install status and best-effort version.

name.description: Agent display name from the ACP registry.

registry_agent_id.description: Matching ACP registry agent ID (e.g. 'claude-acp'). Null for custom wizard-supplied entries that have no registry match.

launch_command.description: Known launch command for this agent. Sourced from the registry's per-platform binary cmd field (e.g. 'claude-acp') or supplied by the user in the wizard's custom path input. Null when neither is available.

protocol_kind.description: Wire protocol kind of the candidate (additive, I-000134 F-7). Null for a legacy producer that does not publish it. A provider entry saved from this candidate uses the same kind.

launch_args.description: Launch arguments that accompany launch_command, e.g. a single "acp" element for agents whose ACP server is a subcommand. Empty for bare native CLI launches and custom wizard-supplied commands.

installed.description: True when the binary referenced by launch_command (or derived from registry distribution metadata) is found on the system PATH via a which-equivalent lookup.

version.description: Best-effort version string from a `--version` probe of the installed binary. Null when the binary is not installed, or when the version probe fails or times out (≤2s timeout).

description.description: Agent description from the ACP registry. Null when no registry entry exists (custom wizard entries).

icon_url.description: Agent icon URL from the ACP registry. Null when no registry entry or icon is available.
